title: Add RAG agent tool-calling quickstarts and docs site updates
author: Ananya Patel
description: Adds a set of RAG agent quickstarts and tool-calling example templates aimed at accelerating developer onboarding and reproducible demos. Motivation: teams frequently request concise examples showing how to wire Redwood's streaming/chat API to an external tool runner (search, web, and action execution) plus a RAG retrieval layer. This PR introduces: 1) a canonical quickstart doc that walks through project setup, retrieval config, and tool registration; 2) two ready-to-run example agents (Python and TypeScript) demonstrating function/tool-calling patterns, structured output handling, and simple retry/fallback logic; 3) templates for RAG prompt/metadata that integrate with the existing eval harness; 4) docs site integration (TOC, quickstarts landing page) and cross-links to the model registry and SDK examples. Checklist: - [x] Add quickstart doc and site page - [x] Add Python and TypeScript example agents - [x] Add tests for example agent behavior - [x] Update docs sidebar and landing page - [x] Add usage notes and migration considerations for existing RAG templates - [x] Run docsite preview and address accessibility/lint warnings Compatibility notes: examples are compatible with the current stable SDKs; Python example pins to SDK v0.19.0 and includes a short note about tokenization differences for quantized model variants. No runtime-breaking changes included.
